dimensions.assessment: Primarily affects federal administrative organization and statutory references concerning the National Park Service.
dimensions.evidence: The purpose of this Act is to make improvements in the enactment of title 54, United States Code, into a positive law title and to correct related technical errors.

dimensions.assessment: Effects are technical, clerical, and administrative in nature, correcting cross-references and headings.
No significant federal spending changes or appropriations are stated, other than minor technical adjustments to existing authorizations.
Spans multiple titles of the U.S. Code and reorganizes provisions within Title 54, but focuses on legal classification rather than new policy creation.
dimensions.evidence: make improvements in the enactment of title 54, United States Code, into a positive law title and to correct related technical errors

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory changes to the United States Code.

missing_information: Specific economic savings or administrative cost impacts of the technical corrections are not estimated.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill makes technical corrections, structural restatements, and clerical updates to Title 54 of the U.S. Code and related laws regarding the National Park Service without creating new major programs.
